title: Re-point lore-check.yml LORE_SOURCE_REF to lore-cli dev squash of #702 after it lands (0.14.2 cut follow-up)
description: Follow-up in the 0.14.2 cut sequence (leader order 2026-10-31). #706 pins LORE_SOURCE_REF in .github/workflows/lore-check.yml to dff81a039ea5d4df7705ef1040802d14e3385b30, the head of lore-cli#702 (chore/LCLI-775-bump-0.14.2). The source fallback does a plain git clone of lore-cli then cat-file -e on that ref (lines ~214-219); a plain clone fetches branches and tags only, so once #702 squash-merges and its branch is auto-deleted, dff81a03 stops resolving and every quest-cli PR lore check goes red until lore 0.14.2 reaches npm latest. Re-point the one field to lore-cli dev squash of #702 (SHA sent by the leader after it lands; verify by ref that its package.json reads 0.14.2 and that it is an ancestor of lore-cli dev). Same one-line field and same precedent as the 0.14.1 bump (#629). The leader floors and reviews it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: LORE_SOURCE_REF in .github/workflows/lore-check.yml names the lore-cli dev squash commit of #702, verified by ref to carry package.json 0.14.2 and to resolve after #702 branch deletion
lore check reports success on the PR carrying it, and scripts/lore-pin-staleness.mjs still reads the pin
No other line of the workflow changes
